title: Parity-dependent coupling of molecular spin chains to a superconductor
title_zh: 分子自旋链与超导体的奇偶依赖性耦合
abstract: Collective behaviour in quantum materials can produce excitations carrying only a fraction of the quantum numbers of their constituents. A notable case occurs in chains of spin-1 units1, in which a topological gap protects the interior of the chain, whereas spin-1/2 states, half the spin of the units that form it, emerge at the ends2. In short chains, these fractional edge spins couple to each other and their topological protection makes them attractive for hybrid spin–superconductor devices. Whether such fractionalization survives the proximity of a superconducting condensate, however, remains an open question. Here we grow molecular Haldane chains of antiferromagnetically coupled spin-1 triangulene units on a proximitized Au(111)/Nb(110) surface and resolve a parity-dependent coupling of their spin-1/2 edge states to the superconductor by scanning tunnelling spectroscopy. Odd-length chains host Yu–Shiba–Rusinov (YSR) bound states inside the superconducting gap, originating from a global S = 1 ground state, whereas even-length chains form an S = 0 ground state decoupled from the superconductor. A two-site model attributes this alternation to the sign and strength of inter-edge interactions, independently confirmed by extra-gap spin excitations in tunnelling spectra. Many-body spin excitations of the S = 1 chain are also detected, decoupled from the superconductor by the much larger Haldane gap. The length-tunable coupling of the edge spins to superconductors opens a route towards molecular spin qubits based on π-conjugated carbon architectures. Scanning tunnelling spectroscopy shows that the fractional spin-1/2 end states of molecular Haldane chains couple differently to a superconducting condensate depending on whether the chain contains an even or odd number of spin-1 triangulene units.
abstract_zh: 量子材料中的集体行为可以产生仅携带其组分量子数分数的激发。一个显著的例子出现在自旋-1单元组成的链中，其中拓扑能隙保护链的内部，而在两端则出现自旋-1/2态（其自旋为构成链的单元自旋的一半）。在短链中，这些分数化的边缘自旋相互耦合，其拓扑保护使其对自旋-超导体混合器件具有吸引力。然而，这种分数化在超导凝聚体邻近下是否保持仍是一个开放的问题。在此，我们在 proximity化的 Au(111)/Nb(110) 表面上生长了由反铁磁耦合自旋-1 三角烯单元组成的分子 Haldane 链，并通过扫描隧道光谱解析了其自旋-1/2 边缘态与超导体的奇偶依赖性耦合。奇数长度链中存在超导能隙内的 Yu-Shiba-Rusinov (YSR) 束缚态，源自全局 S = 1 基态，而偶数长度链形成与超导体解耦的 S = 0 基态。双位点模型将这种交替归因于边缘间相互作用的符号和强度，该结果通过隧道光谱中带隙外的自旋激发得到独立验证。S = 1 链的多体自旋激发也被检测到，由于更大的 Haldane 能隙而与超导体解耦。边缘自旋与超导体之间长度可调的耦合为基于 π 共轭碳架构的分子自旋量子比特开辟了一条路径。扫描隧道光谱表明，分子 Haldane 链的分数化自旋-1/2 端态与超导凝聚体的耦合取决于链中包含奇数或偶数个自旋-1 三角烯单元。
